63:t_1:87.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
[That is her name.]

63:t_1:89.en:
$$エイミー$$
「$$レド$$... So your name is $$レド$$.」

63:t_1:90.en:
$$ガロード$$
「See...? I knew you were hungry.」

63:t_1:91.en:
$$かなめ$$
「Yep, yep. For people, eating comes first.」

63:t_1:94.en:
$$甲児$$
「We can take our time talking afterward.」

63:t_1:95.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「We've got lots of things besides dried fish, so eat all you want.」

63:t_1:97.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
[Their voices suggest they are the soldiers who participated in yesterday's operation. They wish to befriend Ensign $$レド$$.]

63:t_1:100.en:
$$キャシー$$
「Communication between civilizations... Come to think of it, we've done that many times in this multiverse already...」

63:t_1:101.en:
$$キャシー$$
「I believe we can work together with him, just as we have with this fleet.」

63:t_1:106.en:
$$アル$$
「...I will now begin asking about your circumstances.」

63:t_1:108.en:
$$アル$$
「My name is $$アル$$. I am the control AI for the $$ＡＲＸ－７　アーバレスト$$.」

63:t_1:109.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「I am $$チェインバー#pilot$$, this unit's Pilot Support Enlightenment Interface System.」

63:t_1:110.en:
$$アル$$
「I look forward to working with you, $$チェインバー#pilot$$.」

63:t_1:111.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「Request. Explain the meaning of 'look forward to working with you'.」

63:t_1:112.en:
$$アル$$
「It is an expression of affection or friendship. It seems your vocabulary has its own biases.」

63:t_1:113.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「We are currently collecting data to inform our decisions. We request your assistance.」

63:t_1:114.en:
$$アル$$
「Understood. Let us work together for our mutual benefit.」

63:t_1:115.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「What are they doing over there?」

63:t_1:117.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「Is $$アル$$ doing it because they're both robots?」

63:t_1:118.en:
$$ルカ$$
「$$アル$$ volunteered for it himself.」

63:t_1:119.en:
$$ルカ$$
「Since he's an AI, I think he can collect accurate information without subjective opinions getting in the way.」

63:t_1:120.en:
$$かなめ$$
「I'm not so sure about that...」

63:t_1:122.en:
$$かなめ$$
「Sure, $$アル$$ is an AI, and he's better than humans at collecting accurate information. But I don't think it's quite right to say he has no subjective opinions.」

63:t_1:123.en:
$$かなめ$$
「For example, when a human plays chess against a computer, the AI chooses the best move from a vast amount of data, but...」

63:t_1:124.en:
$$かなめ$$
「$$アル$$ seems to tend to favor his own intuition over comparisons with past data.」

63:t_1:127.en:
$$かなめ$$
「Yeah. That's the feeling I got from dealing with $$アル$$ these past few days...」

63:t_1:128.en:
$$かなめ$$
「Of course, I'm speaking on intuition myself.」

63:t_1:129.en:
$$マオ$$
「Well... We can leave that to $$アル$$. Our problem is over here.」

63:t_1:136.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「Unlike their robots, the pilots' conversation isn't getting anywhere.」

63:t_1:137.en:
$$正太郎$$
「I heard $$レド$$ is a soldier who's devoted to his duty too, so I thought they'd have plenty to talk about...」

63:t_1:138.en:
$n
「No... Two quiet types together aren't going to get very far.」

63:t_1:139.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「What are you talking about? You and $$宗介$$ are both the quiet type, $n, and you get along fine.」

63:t_1:140.en:
$n
「...Hey, $$ワッ太$$... I've wanted to ask you for a while. Am I really... that much of the quiet type?」

63:t_1:141.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「Why are you asking that now?」

63:t_1:143.en:
$$正太郎$$
「Um... In your case, $n... I'd say you're reserved, or quiet, or composed...」

63:t_1:144.en:
$n
「...Thanks, $$正太郎$$... But right now, your kindness just makes it hurt more...」

63:t_1:145.en:
$$かなめ$$
「It's a matter of first impressions. When you first transferred in, $n, you did seem cool and hard to approach.」

63:t_1:146.en:
$$かなめ$$
「Well... Now we've seen you have a decent share of the doofus in you, too.」

63:t_1:147.en:
$$正太郎$$
「I don't think that's very comforting...」

63:t_1:148.en:
$$かなめ$$
「Don't worry about it. These things really come down to your own attitude.」

63:t_1:150.en:
$$かなめ$$
「If you hate being called the quiet type so much, go get $$レド$$ to open up.」

63:t_1:151.en:
$n
「...I'm not falling for that. You're trying to dump another headache on me, just like you did with $$宗介$$, aren't you?」

63:t_1:152.en:
$$かなめ$$
「Ah... Ah ha ha... Of course I'd never do that.」

63:t_1:154.en:
$$かなめ$$
「Ugh... I can't fool those eyes of yours, $$正太郎$$...」

63:t_1:155.en:
$$かなめ$$
「All right, then... I'll show you how communication is done.」

63:t_1:156.en:
$n
「$$千鳥$$ is better suited to dealing with the quiet type.」

63:t_1:157.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Hehe... It bothered you more than I thought, $n.」

63:t_1:158.en:
$n
「...Until I came to $$陣代高校$$, the only people I'd really had proper conversations with were Dad and Sis...」

63:t_1:159.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Because you were working as a $$ビーストハンター$$ in the mountains?」

63:t_1:161.en:
$$スズネ$$
(Come to think of it, I've heard about his 《$$ご家族の事故$$》, but he hardly ever talks about what came before...)

63:t_1:171.en:
$$テッサ$$
「Have you finished questioning Ensign $$レド$$?」
